text:
maria: Quick bring-up note for new candidate 'sparrow-mini-int5' on semantic holdout. Ran recall@10/100 + cluster checks on news_holdout_5k.

dev: numbers?

maria: recall@10 baseline (sparrow-v1): 0.788. sparrow-mini-int5: 0.761 (delta -0.027). recall@100 delta smaller (~-0.012). Paired bootstrap p~0.002.

rahul: any pattern by query length or topic?

maria: Short tech queries and code-like queries most impacted. Cluster compactness down: mean intra-cos 0.66 -> 0.61. UMAP shows topic smear for 'api' and 'sdk' clusters.

dev: config & quick repro?

maria: ```bash
./eval_embeddings.sh --model sparrow-mini-int5 --holdout news_holdout_5k --k 10 --resamples 500 --save-samples
```

viz-bot: Generated UMAP & per-topic drift plots at /artifacts/6390001234/umap.zip

rahul: try per-channel quant and bias-correction on output norms. Also run a 5->6-bit hybrid to see cost->quality knee.

maria: queued per-channel + norm-bias sweep. Will post results and top failed sample IDs for manual QA.
